The**Ministry of Inclusion, Social Security and Migration**is a[department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_government_departments)of the[government of Spain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Spain)responsible for planning and carrying out the government policy on[Social Security](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_security_in_Spain),[foreigners](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alien_(law)),[immigration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Immigration)and[emigration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emigration).

The Ministry's purpose is to guarantee a sufficient and sustainable[pension system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pension_system), to establish new inclusive policies that reduce inequality, uncertainty and[social exclusion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_exclusion)and to develop a new legal framework to order and give security for migrants.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_Inclusion,_Social_Security_and_Migration#cite_note-1)The major policy planne
